about: WebHID + Companion traffic captured from ASUS Gear Link 1.00.24 (gearlink.asus.com, bundle view/7453 chunk-1.00.24-7453-1769649440-670a1c) driving the ROG Falchion Ace HFX ZywOo Edition, 2026-10-11. Hex strings have trailing zero bytes stripped; every out report is 64 bytes on report id 0. See PROTOCOL.md.

device.name: ROG FALCHION ACE HFX ZYWOO EDITION
device.asusModel: M606 (Companion file names use the m605-7453- prefix)

hidInterfaces.control: collection ff00:0001, report id 0, 64-byte output + input (commands and echoes)
hidInterfaces.events: collections 000c:0001 + ffc0:0001, input report id 3 (0x71 key bitmaps, 0x76/0x91 events)

entryFormat.t: ms since the recorder was injected
entryFormat.step: the UI action being performed (the preceding mark)
entryFormat.dir/kind: out sendReport = host->keyboard; in input = keyboard->host on the control interface; in event = event interface (report id 3, 0x71 key bitmaps filtered out); ws = Gear Link Companion
entryFormat.hex: report payload without the report id, trailing zeros stripped
entryFormat.echo: true when the keyboard answered with an identical input report; echo_ms = latency
entryFormat.noise_removed: repeated 60060000/60120000 Companion polls, ws://localhost:8000+ port scan, 0x71 key-press bitmaps, base64 file_data bodies (only their length is kept)
